plain_description: **Create videos from text prompts, images, and existing footage.** Generate or extend clips, guide them with multiple keyframes, and use ComfyUI workflows for visual control.
technical_description: LTX-Video is an open video-generation model for text-to-video and image-to-video, with support for keyframe conditioning, video extension, video-to-video transformations, and controlled generation. The repository provides local inference through Python and integrations with ComfyUI and Diffusers. It includes FP8 and 8-bit quantized model variants and can be fine-tuned through the separate LTX-Video-Trainer project. The README says this repository is no longer under active development and is retained for its original v0.9.x models.
title: LTX-Video (Legacy)
